solves.reason: (A) sensitive — more sensitive to substances. (B) influence — differences influence habits. (C) reduce — reduce risk.
(A) consume — tend to consume fewer foods. (B) reducing — thereby reducing likelihood. (C) disadvantage — only health disadvantage.
(A) repercussions — have repercussions for health. (B) likelihood — reducing likelihood. (C) identified — disadvantage identified.
③ discard — 'discard fewer high-fat foods' is unnatural. Original: consume(섭취하다).
② favorably — reacting favorably to alcohol contradicts reducing drinking problems. Original: negatively.
④ worse — conclusion is supertasters have BETTER habits. worse is opposite of original.
sweet and bitter substances — natural collocation for what supertasters are sensitive to.
reducing their likelihood of developing — likelihood collocates with 'of developing'.
only health disadvantage — the context describes a negative aspect (vegetable avoidance).
respond ≈ react. Both mean to show a reaction to something.
consume ≈ eat. In food context, consume means to eat/ingest.
influence ≈ affect. Both mean to have an effect on something.
reduce ↔ increase. Opposite directions on a quantity scale.
sensitive ↔ numb. Sensitive means responsive to stimuli, numb means lacking sensation.
(A) verb: 영향을 미치다 (to influence). (B) noun: 영향력 (influence/power). ① matches.
unintended consequence = repercussion. Definition matches perfectly.
Subject 'These differences' is plural + present tense → base form 'influence' (not 'influences').
thereby + V-ing pattern → reducing (present participle in participial phrase).
thereby = as a result of that. Connects negative reaction to alcohol with reduced likelihood.
have repercussions for = have effects/consequences for. Natural collocation.
